title: NB Bancorp, Inc. and Provident Bancorp, Inc. Announce Closing of Merger
summary: NB Bancorp, Inc. ("Needham") (NASDAQ: NBBK), the holding company for Needham Bank, and Provident Bancorp, Inc. ("Provident") (NASDAQ: PVBC), the holding company for BankProv, today jointly announced that: All closing conditions under the Merger Agreement (as defined below) have been satisfied and the parties have initiated steps to complete the Merger Transaction (as defined below) contemplated by the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated June 5, 2025, among Needham, Needham Bank, 1828 MS Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Needham formed solely to facilitate the transaction ("Merger Sub"), Provident, and BankProv (the "Merger Agreement").
